Resolutions of 1970

16 resolutions, 50% unanimous. Decolonisation.

  • 276 (1970) Establishment of an Ad Hoc Subcommittee of the Council to study ways to implement Council resolutions regarding Namibia
  • 277 (1970) Expansion of sanctions against the Southern Rhodesia régime
  • 278 (1970) The question of Bahrain
  • 279 (1970) Withdrawal of Israeli armed forces from Lebanon
  • 280 (1970) Israeli military actions against Lebanon
  • 281 (1970) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
  • 282 (1970) Arms embargo against South Africa
  • 283 (1970) Requesting all States to refrain from any relations with South Africa implying recognition of South African authority over Namibia
  • 284 (1970) Requesting an advisory opinion of the International Court of Justice on the presence of South Africa in Namibia
  • 285 (1970) Withdrawal of Israeli armed forces from Lebanon
  • 286 (1970) Hijacking of commercial aircraft
  • 287 (1970) Admission of Fiji to membership in the United Nations
  • 288 (1970) Deciding that sanctions against Southern Rhodesia shall remain in force
  • 289 (1970) Immediate cessation of armed attack against Guinea
  • 290 (1970) Portuguese military actions against Guinea
  • 291 (1970) Extension of the stationing in Cyprus of the UN Peace-keeping Force
